description.value: Tantalus Vineyards is a boutique estate winery on the eastern slopes of the Okanagan Valley, operating on one of BC's oldest continuously producing vineyards — first planted to grapes in 1927. It holds the distinction of being British Columbia's first LEED-certified winery, and has earned a national and international reputation for its terroir-driven Riesling, Chardonnay, and Pinot Noir. Touring cyclists can book a tasting experience overlooking Lake Okanagan and the City of Kelowna.
